messages:
maria.g: FYI security pushed an egress-hardening rollout to prod VPCs ~8m ago. Noticed a spike in provisioning errors in aus-southeast. Could be related to keystore access.
kai: seeing many GPU nodes stuck in Provisioning in aus-southeast-1a/b.
andrew: logs show agent failing to fetch keystore token with 403s.
maria.g: snippet from node agent: `ERROR fetch_keystore: 403 Forbidden from https://keystore.internal/v1/session` — looks like outbound blocked.
ops-bot: Security Change: egress-policy/v3 applied to vpc-prod-llm (by security-runner). Summary: default deny outbound; allowlist -> {10.0.0.0/16, 52.120.0.0/14}. Rollout: immediate.
maria.g: that allowlist doesn't include keystore subnet (10.45.128.0/24) nor allocator service endpoints.
jeff.sre: consequence: allocator can't complete auth handshake -> nodes remain NotReady -> warm-pool drains -> latency goes up; some traffic falling back to CPU instances.
kai: metrics: warm-pool -28% in target AZs, avg provisioning latency +8min, failed launches ~20%.
andrew: quick mitigation options: 1) add keystore CIDR to allowlist 2) rollback egress change 3) add per-subnet exception 4) temporary NAT route via management subnet. Thoughts?
maria.g: minimal change preferred: add keystore cidr and a short-lived canary rollout so we don't reintroduce broad egress access.
kai: +1. Also request a per-AZ exception for `subnet-llm-a/b` to speed recovery.
andrew: opening CR now to security; will include rollback plan.
ops-bot: Change Request CR#2237 opened by andrew. Window: immediate. Rollback: restore previous ACL JSON.
security-runner: Change applied: appended 10.45.128.0/24 to egress allowlist for vpc-prod-llm. Rule id: egress-allow-keystore-2237.
jeff.sre: can someone curl the keystore from one of the stuck tiles?
maria.g: running quick smoke from a stuck node: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://keystore.internal/v1/ping` -> 200
kai: warm-pool rebuild triggered; two nodes reached Ready within 70s.
andrew: metrics updating: failed launch rate falling to <2%, warm-pool delta -4% now.
maria.g: root cause summary: egress-hardening change excluded critical infra CIDR. Remediation: add preflight checks in the change pipeline that validate the allowlist covers an "egress service registry" of critical infra services.
jeff.sre: logging action: create ENG-OPS-2245 to build the egress service registry and link to pipeline preflight. Assigning to kai.
ops-bot: Ticket ENG-OPS-2245 created; owner set to kai.
kai: checklist once change is in place: 1) curl keystore from staging and prod node 2) verify agent token fetch logs 3) trigger warm-pool joins 4) monitor p50.
maria.g: finance: can we get a delta on cost impact from 8-26m window? We saw CPU fallback and extra NAT egress due to retries.
andrew: preliminary estimate ~800 USD for the window. I'll loop in finance for an exact number.
jeff.sre: post-incident actions: 1) add service tags (`keystore`, `allocator`) and CIDRs to egress policy docs; 2) implement pipeline preflight check; 3) update runbook with mapping of critical services to CIDRs.
maria.g: thanks all for the quick recovery. Closing thread after finance confirms delta. :thumbsup:
